title: Egyptian Vegan Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful North African-inspired stew made with aromatic spices and served over couscous.
instructions: Heat oil in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add tagine spice mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and water, and stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in couscous and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
